basics.name: Omar Olivares Urrutia
basics.label: AI Engineer, LLM Systems and Evaluation
basics.summary: AI engineer building production LLM systems: agents, retrieval, evaluation, and MCP tooling. Co-author of a peer-reviewed LLM evaluation study (DataEd'26, 19 models on 300 SQL cases), early engineer on Kilo Code, an open-source coding agent with about 10,000 GitHub stars, and builder of a retrieval system over more than 200,000 scientific papers. I work mainly in Python and FastAPI.

work.name: Maxxa Software SpA
work.summary: Fintech company offering credit and surety products. Responsible for the production LLM platform on the technology team: governance, evaluation, observability, and agent tooling.
highlights: Built governance, evaluation, and observability tooling for the LLMs behind the company's financial products
Delivered core and enterprise LLM platform features used across internal AI products
Built a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents and internal teams access to company data and tools

work.name: Universidad de Talca
work.summary: LLM platform for SQL education that gives students real-time feedback on their queries.
highlights: Designed a multi-agent pipeline that reviews each query for syntax, semantic, and logic errors
Compared Grok, GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek models on tutoring quality
Built an evaluation suite covering 19 LLMs and 300 cases, using LLM-as-a-judge scoring and human-annotated ground truth
Co-authored a peer-reviewed paper on LLM detection of SQL errors, accepted at DataEd'26

work.name: Kilo Code
work.summary: Early hire on the 12-person founding team of Kilo Code, an open-source coding agent descended from Cline and Roo Code.
highlights: Helped launch the project and grow it to about 10,000 GitHub stars
Built the OpenRouter integrations and documentation that supported its #1 ranking on OpenRouter
Wrote developer onboarding guides and reference integrations
Worked with leadership, including Sid Sijbrandij's team, on technical architecture and go-to-market

work.name: Emergent Mind
work.summary: Search and analysis over arXiv papers, built on a production retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system.

Built daily arXiv ingestion and indexing pipelines and an evaluation harness in Weights & Biases
Deployed FastAPI services in Docker with tracing and reliability tests
